item.title: New York Times Columnist Tom Friedman Plays His Readers for Fools—Again
item.description: "Netanyahu Plays Trump and American Jews for Fools—Again" is the headline over Thomas Friedman's latest column in the New York Times. I read the "again" part as an admission by Friedman that he's been writing the same column for decades.
